risks.risk: TV may not be working at all (transformer claim could be wrong; could be mainboard/T-con/backlight issues).
risks.proof: A short video showing the TV powered on with a test pattern (full screen) and sound, plus a close-up of any standby/light behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / scrap-level value.

risks.risk: Screen damage (lines/dead pixels) may exist but is not visible in the dark/reflection photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos while ON: solid colors (red/green/blue/white/black) and a grid pattern to check lines and dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible display faults.

risks.risk: Remote may be missing or not functional.
risks.proof: Photo of the remote and a clip showing it controlling volume/channel on the TV.

risks.risk: Brand/model/size may be different from what’s claimed, affecting value.
risks.proof: Photo of the TV label/sticker (back or side) showing brand, model number, and screen size.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic small LG flat-screen with unknown model.

proof_requests: Photo of the TV back label/sticker showing LG model number and screen size.
Video: TV powered ON showing a test pattern (full screen) + sound (to confirm working state).
Close-up photos while ON of solid colors/grid to confirm no dead pixels/lines.
Photo of the remote; then a short clip proving the remote works with the TV.
Photo of the back panel opened (or power board area) showing the transformer/power supply condition (or any diagnostic note).
response.reason: The photo does not clearly confirm the LG model/size or the claimed transformer-only fault, and the screen/remote status cannot be verified from the single dark image. Without proof of working/display condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the provided comparables.
